property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) always succeeds (does not revert) in the reference implementation; the mutant adds a require that reverts unless newOwner equals the current owner, thus causing transferOwnership to fail for some valid inputs where owner transfers to a different address.
change_summary: Added an extra require that newOwner must equal the current owner, preventing normal ownership transfers (only allows no-op transfers to same owner).
